## Summary

This note records a bounded-theorem conditional decomposition for the
color-singlet-records gate. It does not derive the g2 antecedent,
conditionally or otherwise, as an equality. It establishes a CONDITIONAL
SUFFICIENT DECOMPOSITION for record-level color indistinguishability -- a
strictly weaker statement than "physical records are color singlets" -- under
named premises:

```text
LOCK-LOCAL (axiom text)
AND MARGINAL-READ (named premise, not axiom content)
AND PHASE-FREE (this note's exact mechanism)
AND WEIGHT-UNIFORMITY (named condition; two sufficient routes)
  => no record-readable phase or weight distinction between color orientations.
```

The marginal-to-singlet gap is stated as an explicit residual: record-level
indistinguishability does not prove the physical record state lies in the
trivial `SU(3)` representation.

The honesty core is negative and exact. Bare record site-locality does not make records color-blind. In the `Sym^2(C^2)` edge block, `|00>` and `|11>` have distinct single-site marginals, so a site-local record can distinguish them. The bare-locality route to g2 is refuted.

What survives: record content is site-local, so record-visible edge data factors through single-site marginals; orientation phases are invisible by exact marginal computation (this note's own load-bearing mechanism), with the landed June-10 phase-free row cited only as adjacent surface on its own homomorphism boundary; the remaining local datum is marginal weight. WEIGHT-UNIFORMITY has two sufficient routes: AD-INV, cited at retained-bounded scope and presupposing link structure, and CLOSED-SHELL, recomputed here from the three-mode fermionic Fock space.

The conclusion is conditional and premise-named. This note does not choose
the physical sectors, does not decide open shells, does not resolve the
einselection circularity, and does not close the marginal-to-singlet gap.

MARGINAL-READ (named premise, introduced here): record-visible data about an
edge state is represented at the state level by single-site reduced density
matrices. The Record axiom licenses site-locality of record content and
content-only readout; it does NOT identify record content with reduced
density matrices. MARGINAL-READ is therefore a modeling bridge carried as a
named conditional premise. Every "record-invisible" statement below is unconditional
only in its "single-site-marginal-invisible" form and upgrades to
"record-invisible" exactly under MARGINAL-READ.

## T1 -- LOCK-LOCAL and the exact insufficiency exhibit

**T1 (exact math, runner-verified; the record-reading form is conditional on
MARGINAL-READ):** record content is site-local by the Record axiom: a record
locks one admissible local possibility, no site carries more than one record,
and readout values are determined by record content alone. UNDER
MARGINAL-READ, record-visible data about an edge state depends on that edge
only through the single-site marginals. Without MARGINAL-READ, T1's exact
content is the marginal mathematics itself; the axioms alone do not supply
the state-level representation.

This is only a factorization statement. It is not color-blindness.

Exact exhibit: in the symmetric block of an edge, with basis

```text
|00>, (|01> + |10>)/sqrt(2), |11>,
```

the two symmetric states `|00>` and `|11>` have different single-site marginals:

```text
rho_x(|00>) = diag(1, 0),   rho_x(|11>) = diag(0, 1),
rho_y(|00>) = diag(1, 0),   rho_y(|11>) = diag(0, 1).
```

Their single-site trace distance is exactly `1`, hence positive. A site-local record can distinguish them. Bare LOCK-LOCAL does not force records to be color singlets. The bare-locality route to g2 is exactly refuted by this exhibit.

## T2 -- PHASE-FREE has two independent mechanisms

**T2 (exact):** orientation phases are single-site-marginal-invisible (and hence record-invisible under MARGINAL-READ), two independent ways.

First, the marginal computation is exact. For

```text
psi_theta = (|00> + exp(i theta) |11>) / sqrt(2),
```

both single-site marginals are

```text
(|0><0| + |1><1|) / 2
```

for every theta. The off-diagonal terms vanish under the partial trace because the supported product states have different partner-site labels. This is a symbolic support calculation, not a numerical sweep.

Second, this note's own finite compact-phase core, recomputed exactly (the landed June-10 row is adjacent surface only, scoped to its quoted homomorphism boundary; it is not consumed for general record phase-freeness): if an additive continuous phase readout has the local form `I(theta) = c theta` on a compact phase, then single-valuedness gives

```text
c theta = c (theta + 2 pi),
```

so `2 pi c = 0` and `c = 0`. This is the phase-free part only. It does not by itself force weight uniformity.

## T3 -- WEIGHT-UNIFORMITY has two sufficient routes

**T3 (conditional, runner-verified where recomputed):** after LOCK-LOCAL and PHASE-FREE, the remaining single-site datum is marginal weight. Define WEIGHT-UNIFORMITY as the condition that the color marginal is proportional to the identity:

```text
rho_color = I3 / 3.
```

There are two sufficient routes.

**AD-INV route.** The June 9 depolarization row
(`matter_color_depolarization_necessary_for_gauge_link_ad_invariance_narrow_theorem_note_2026-06-09`,
`retained_bounded`) is consumed by note + audited claim scope, quoted verbatim
from the audit ledger:

> "Given the supplied C^3 color carrier and a nonzero SU(3)-equivariant
> linear matter-current drift into su(3), Ad-invariance of the Lie-algebra
> increment first moment forces rho_color = I_3/3."

Every condition in that scope travels with the citation: the SUPPLIED `C^3`
color carrier, the nonzero `SU(3)`-equivariant linear drift, and
Ad-invariance of the increment first moment. The route therefore presupposes
link/carrier structure -- the einselection circularity caution. This note
names the caution and does not resolve it.

**CLOSED-SHELL route (named premise FERMI-FILL).** This route is
link-structure-free but NOT presupposition-free: it presupposes fermionic
(Pauli/CAR) statistics on the three color modes and full filling -- content
the four axioms (qubit site domains) do not supply. That presupposition is
carried as the named premise FERMI-FILL. Under FERMI-FILL the runner
recomputes the finite core exactly. Build the fermionic Fock space on three
color modes. Its dimension is `2^3 = 8`. Let the filled state be obtained by applying the three creation operators to the vacuum. The one-body matrix

```text
Gamma_ij = <filled| c_i^dagger c_j |filled>
```

is exactly `delta_ij`. After normalization by particle number `3`,

```text
rho_color = Gamma / 3 = I3 / 3.
```

This route presupposes FERMI-FILL (fermionic statistics plus full filling of the three color modes) and nothing about links. It does not select which physical sectors are closed-shell. The OPEN-SHELL complement is the exact open residual.

## T4 -- Conditional sufficient decomposition (NOT an equality, NOT g2 itself)

**T4 (bounded classification pinned to T1-T3):** under the named premises,
record-level color indistinguishability follows:

```text
LOCK-LOCAL AND MARGINAL-READ AND PHASE-FREE AND WEIGHT-UNIFORMITY
  => no record-readable phase or weight distinction between color
     orientations on the edge block.
```

This is a one-directional sufficiency statement. It is NOT an equality, and
it is NOT the g2 antecedent: "no record-readable distinction" (marginal
indistinguishability) is strictly weaker than "the physical record state
lies in the trivial SU(3) representation." The gap is the explicit residual
R-singlet-gap below. Which form the June-5 bridge's consumer actually needs
-- full singletness or record-level indistinguishability -- is an open check
recorded there, not decided here.

WEIGHT-UNIFORMITY's two sufficient routes and their presuppositions:

```text
AD-INV      retained_bounded, consumed at its audited claim scope
            (supplied C^3 carrier + nonzero equivariant drift +
            Ad-invariant first moment); presupposes link/carrier structure.
FERMI-FILL  recomputed exact here; link-structure-free; presupposes
            fermionic statistics + full filling (not axiom content).
```

The OPEN-SHELL complement is the exact open residual. Bare LOCK-LOCAL is
insufficient by T1's exhibit.
